recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: contract-grade verifiers stress-testing machine-written GPU kernels
Fourier transforms sketched out by hand on graph paper
overcast San Francisco summer evening at seventeen degrees
fog rolling through the bay before sunset

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap when handwritten Fourier wave peaks align with a scrolling frequency grid — mistimed taps smear ink and ruin the harmonic.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap on wave peaks as they cross grid lines
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: lock three clean harmonics before the notebook page floods with smudges.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: waves stack faster and decoy harmonics appear between real peaks.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag GPU kernel contract clauses into pass or fail bins before the verifier timeout — green decoys look valid but explode on submission.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clear one kernel's full contract before the compile clock hits zero.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: clause count doubles each wave and fake-green decoys multiply.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe terminal on matte black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick sandbags onto a levee wall as monsoon rain sheets down — under-flicks bounce off, over-flicks collapse the wall segment.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: flick sandbags from dock to wall slots
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: seal the levee before water breaches in sixty seconds.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: rain intensity spikes and wind shifts target slots mid-round.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: ink-wash watercolor storm over grey rooftops

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one continuous path from phone icon to agent terminal through rotating iOS shortcut gates — lift your finger and the deployment chain resets.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag without lifting through shortcut widget gates
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one clean agent launch chain per thirty-second round.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: gates rotate mid-draw and decoy shortcuts fork the path.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: frosted glass iOS widgets over midnight blue fog
